sources.title: [2608.14530] Marionette: Predicting World States, Rendering Geometry ...
sources.snippet: We explicitly model the evolving world state, delegate exact geometric computation to a fixed, zero-parameter renderer, and leave the neural model to synthesize appearance. We instantiate this idea as Marionette, a world model for interactive games with articulated characters.
